Ready for local main integration as an opt-in engineering checkpoint. The default-budget boundary diagnostic still refuses all 16 cases on curvature; original-model certification, decoder qualification, peak live memory and complete throughput remain open. No production admission or ticket closure follows. The combined candidate/report are saved separately on review/phrf-main-ready-20261008; this review does not move main or publish to GitHub.
